Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: PT Planner for Vercel deployment

- React frontend with Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Vercel serverless API functions
- Prisma ORM with Neon PostgreSQL support
- JWT authentication
- Full CRUD for trainers, participants, training types
- Appointments management with calendar
- Reports and invoicing system

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix TypeScript build errors for Vercel deployment

- Remove unused imports \(Clock, addHours\)
- Remove unused editAppointment prop
- Add vite-env.d.ts for import.meta.env types

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Consolidate API routes for Vercel Hobby plan \(12 function limit\)

Reduced from 19 serverless functions to 8 by combining routes:
- auth/[...path].ts: login, register, me
- trainers/[[...params]].ts: list, create, get, update, delete
- participants/[[...params]].ts: list, create, get, update, delete
- training-types/[[...params]].ts: list, create, get, update, delete
- appointments/[[...params]].ts: list, create, get, update, delete, status
- reports/[[...params]].ts: get report, get participants
- invoices/[[...params]].ts: list, create, get, delete, stats, status
- health.ts: health check

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Rename api/_lib to api/lib for Vercel compatibility

Vercel ignores files/folders starting with underscore in serverless functions.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
